description: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-Audio: a FastConformer audio encoder feeding an LFM2 hybrid short-conv/attention backbone, loaded from the llama.cpp-format GGUF components Liquid publishes. ASR only for now.

request.name: language
request.description: Must match the checkpoint's language (en or ja) when given; each published checkpoint transcribes one language.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum number of generated transcript tokens per audio chunk.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Audio chunking mode: auto, fixed, or none.

session.name: model_gguf
session.description: Backbone GGUF, relative to the model directory. Defaults to the directory's only backbone GGUF.

session.name: mmproj_gguf
session.description: Audio encoder (mmproj) GGUF, relative to the model directory. Defaults to mmproj-<backbone GGUF name>.

ui.summary: LFM2.5-Audio transcription (English and Japanese checkpoints) from Liquid's published GGUFs.
